text: Voluntary Account Closure and Reactivation Document ID: SOP_C21_ACCOUNT_CLOSURE Category: C21 — Termination & Deactivation Department: Customer Care Customer Scope: all Version: 1.0 Last Updated: 2026-08-08 Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base Purpose To standardise the closure of active connections and reactivation of connections deactivated for non-payment. Scope Applies to all channels and customer segments unless a specific exception is noted below. Preconditions Customer identity verified (registered number and OTP where applicable). Account is active and not under a fraud, legal, or compliance hold. Roles & Responsibilities Required Information Registered mobile number / account ID. Nature of the request and any reference numbers already issued. Relevant transaction or ticket ID, where applicable. Procedure Verify request details. Apply the standard resolution steps. Confirm outcome with the customer. Decision Points If the request qualifies under standard criteria, proceed with automatic processing. If suspected fraud indicators are present at any step, halt standard processing and route per the Fraud & Security Response SOP. Exception Handling Cases outside standard scope require supervisor sign-off before proceeding. Validation Confirm the account/system reflects the expected end state before the case is closed, and obtain customer confirmation where applicable. Escalation Unresolved cases are automatically flagged for supervisor review after the stated SLA window, ensuring no request is left without a defined next action. SLA / Timing First-line resolution target is same working day; escalations to specialist teams carry a 2-3 working day SLA. Audit Requirements Every action taken under this SOP must be logged against the account with agent ID,
title: Voluntary Account Closure and Reactivation
